name: Mechanistic
source:
A short story of walking a boy home after he loses track of time at club. Listen to his strange thoughts about being like a machine...

[From [url=https://bluefish9.itch.io/mechanistic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個短篇故事。一個男孩參加社團活動忘了時間，你陪他走路回家。一路上聽他說些奇異的念頭，說自己像一臺機器……

［摘自[url=https://bluefish9.itch.io/mechanistic]Itch.io[/url]］
